description: Cross-validation of the SPHinXsys TransportVelocityCorrection operator ported to TensorSPH, scored against the Martin & Moyce (1952) dam-break experiment.

source.paper: Martin, J.C. & Moyce, W.J. (1952). An experimental study of the collapse of liquid columns on a rigid horizontal plane. Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London. Series A, Mathematical and Physical Sciences, 244(882), 312-324.

digitization.method: Digitized from open-access review papers, cross-referenced with multiple CFD validation studies

verdict.baseline_comparison: TVC reduces MAE from 0.621 to 0.143 (4.3x improvement) and relative error from 51.0% to 10.8% (4.7x improvement) at dx=0.03
limitations: Fixed alpha=0.10 is calibrated for dx in [0.02, 0.03]; at dx=0.01 the error rises to 16.4% (requires alpha=0.15 for 14.3%)
The 'improves convergence' claim is falsified for fixed alpha: error is non-monotone with refinement (17.1/10.6/12.5/16.4% at dx=0.04/0.03/0.02/0.01)
No live SPHinXsys binary comparison (no Boost/TBB in the image); operator leg verified by exact transcription test
